rows.what_the_ink_shows: This is a handwritten mathematical page. The underlined heading is « Tests décisifs »; a) mentions a smooth X_0 over k, with affine inserted above the line, and the definition of W.M.; b) discusses a smooth proper lifting and ends with De Rham cohomology H_DR(X/S). The concluding paragraph calls the proposal a first esquisse and ends « Il y a du pain en perspective ! ». The only lower-margin notation is the handwritten page number 18. There is no IMAG cover heading or printed cover content, and the editorial locator list « cote 7, scans 1, 19 » is absent. Evidence: crops/7_scan019_L740_tests_decisifs.jpg and crops/7_scan019_L740_concluding_paragraph.jpg; the complete assigned scan was inspected.
